title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent tasks or RL environments Terms US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
description: About Mitre Media Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time. Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect! About the Role As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions. You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality. Responsibilities Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8) Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences. Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions. Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing. Required Technical Skills Back-End Ruby (5+ years, expert-level) Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred) PostgreSQL (or MySQL) Elasticsearch Redis Docker Front-End StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6 Tailwind CSS HTML HTTP AI Integration Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic) Nice-to-Have Technical Skills Kubernetes for microservices orchestration React for advanced front-end components Graph databases for complex financial data Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects Required Soft Skills Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code Team player comfortable as an individual contributor Why Join Us? Cutting-Edge Tech : Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture. Autonomy and Influence : Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate. Competitive Compensation : $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits. Remote Flexibility : Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC Growth Opportunities : Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation. Dynamic Culture : Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data. title: Demand Generation & Marketing Manager
description: About REPLUG REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value and long-term business growth. We connect acquisition, retention, measurement and app experience into a unified growth system that improves commercial performance. From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently and build sustainable growth. Our work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across App Store Optimization, Paid User Acquisition, CRM, measurement and mobile growth consulting. We are looking for a Demand Generation & Marketing Manager to build and run a marketing function that makes a measurable contribution to REPLUG’s commercial growth. Your primary objective is to generate qualified demand and sales opportunities from the businesses we want to work with, with a particular focus on higher-value engagements. You’ll own the marketing plan, its execution and its performance. Working closely with the founders and Sales, you’ll decide where marketing should focus, challenge assumptions and connect marketing activity to qualified conversations, opportunities and pipeline value. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You’ll combine commercial judgement with strong content and practical CRM skills, while ensuring our positioning and the experience prospects have with REPLUG remain consistent. Success will be measured primarily through qualified opportunities generated, the quality and value of pipeline created, and marketing’s contribution to commercial growth. What You’ll Do Generate Demand from the Right Businesses Plan and execute B2B campaigns around the problems, buying triggers and decision-makers within our priority customer profiles. Choose and test the right mix of channels, including LinkedIn, email, partnerships, webinars and events, with a clear route from engagement to conversation. Build campaign assets, landing pages and follow-up journeys. Work with Sales to improve targeting and lead quality using feedback from real conversations. Own the Marketing Plan and Delivery Translate business objectives into a clear marketing plan with priorities, campaigns, timelines, budgets and measures of success. Make decisions about where to invest time and resources, explain your reasoning and challenge activities that lack a clear purpose. Deliver core marketing activities yourself and coordinate contributions from founders, specialists and external partners. Keep delivery moving and identify where additional support is needed. Own Content and Distribution Coordinate founder and team LinkedIn activity, turning specialist insights and client results into relevant content for prospective buyers. Create and commission case studies, website content and campaign materials. Own briefs, editorial quality, distribution and reuse across channels. Develop partner activity that extends our reach into the right audiences. Keep messaging, tone and the prospect experience consistent across touchpoints. Own CRM and Lead Nurturing Own HubSpot marketing processes, including segmentation, forms, workflows, email nurturing, campaign tracking and data quality. Build nurture journeys for contacts at different stages of interest, including those who fit our target profile but are not ready to buy. Agree qualification criteria and handover processes with Sales. Make sure relevant leads reach the right person with useful context and clear next steps. Understand Performance and Improve It Track how marketing contributes to qualified conversations and pipeline. Report marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced opportunities separately. Review conversion between stages with Sales, identify where prospects drop out and adjust campaigns, messaging or nurturing accordingly. Use results to decide what to continue, change or stop. Explain what is working, what remains uncertain and what you will test next. What We’re Looking For We care about demonstrated impact and your personal contribution. You should be able to explain a campaign you owned, the decisions you made, and the commercial opportunities it generated. 3 to 5 years of proven, hands-on B2B marketing experience, including campaigns designed to generate qualified demand for services or products through a considered sales process. Commercial awareness and a clear understanding of customer fit, lead qualification, sales cycles and pipeline progression. Strong content judgement and excellent written and spoken English. You can turn specialist knowledge into clear, credible messaging for buyers. Practical HubSpot experience, including segmentation, workflows, nurturing and reporting. You can build and improve the setup yourself. Experience owning a marketing plan and delivering it within limited resources, while coordinating colleagues and external contributors. The confidence to challenge the founders constructively, make recommendations and take responsibility for the outcome. Good brand judgement and the ability to balance immediate demand generation with long-term credibility. Nice to Have Experience marketing an agency, consultancy or other B2B services business. Familiarity with mobile marketing, AdTech or the app growth ecosystem. Experience building demand through founder visibility, expert content, partnerships or industry events. Based in a location with convenient flight connections to Berlin, Germany. What We Offer Ownership of REPLUG’s marketing plan, with senior marketing guidance, direct access to the founders and influence over priorities. Access to REPLUG’s specialists, client results and industry relationships. You’ll lead and coordinate delivery, with specialist support so you can focus your hands-on work where it has the greatest impact. The opportunity to shape how REPLUG reaches its next clients and demonstrate a clear contribution to business growth. A fully remote setup, with travel opportunities to attend industry and REPLUG’s events A EUR 1,000 annual educational budget Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
